Hydrogen ions are formed when a hydrogen atom loses its electron, as when acids dissociate in water. In exercise physiology, they build up when anaerobic glycolysis runs at a high rate. In that pathway glucose is converted to pyruvate and then lactate, and the H⁺ released along the way lowers muscle pH. I'm taking the glycolysis point from the team note rather than checking it myself, and I'm unsure which context your question intends.

CONFIDENCE: 66
